text:
anya.design: Quick thread for Sable theme tweaks. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/sable-theme 1 — main asks: inline code legibility in docs and chart color collisions on 13" screens.
zoe.design: Looks great overall. Inline snippets at 12px feel low-contrast. Maybe a tiny rounded pill or bump fg for inline only.
gabe.frontend: Pill means extra DOM markup in markdown renderer; we can do it but prefer token-only change first. Can you paste the tokens?
anya.design: tokens snapshot:
--bg: #06090b; --surface: #0e1315; --muted-text: #98a6ab; --text: #e9f3f5; --code-bg: #071217; --code-fg: #bfeaff; --kw: #6be3ff; --str: #ffd9b0; --fn: #d7bfff; --accent1: #23b09a; --accent2: #ff6c58; --accent3: #f2b600
matt.metrics: On narrow dashboards, accent2 and accent3 overlap visually when series are dense. Prefer accents with clearer luminance separation.
keiko.a11y: Automated contrast scan: --muted-text on --surface = 3.0:1 (fails AA). code-fg on code-bg = 4.8:1 (marginal for small inline). Recommend bumping --muted-text to ~#c6d7db or add inline pill for code. Also add --focus-ring token.
palette-bot: Suggested palette adjustments: accent1 -> #00b39f, accent2 -> #ff5a50, accent3 -> #f2b200. CVD sims: improved separability for common modes.
zoe.design: Two approaches: A) bump --muted-text to #c6d7db and switch accents to bot's picks (minimal engineering), or B) keep muted but implement inline pill + chart halos (more engineering + perf). Thoughts?
gabe.frontend: Vote A. Single token changes are easiest and avoid perf costs on charts. We can schedule inline pill in a follow-up PR.
anya.design: OK leaning A. I'll update tokens: --muted-text: #c6d7db, --accent1:#00b39f, --accent2:#ff5a50, --accent3:#f2b200, add --focus-ring:#ffd86b. I'll open a token PR with a short smoke checklist for accessibility and charts.
keiko.a11y: Will draft the checklist: contrast spots, keyboard focus, inline code checks, chart legend readability, and screen reader label for theme toggle. Recommend labeling toggle "Theme: Dark / Light" and high-contrast toggle copy: "High contrast (improves legibility)".
matt.metrics: After token PR, I'll run perf checks on graph rendering and post a small note if any regressions.
anya.design: Thanks team 1 — will tag people on the PR. If no objections by EOD I'll merge the tokens and schedule the inline-pill renderer work for next sprint.
